newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says Middle East peace "out of its hands".
newsitem.headline: EU says Middle East peace "out of its hands".

text.p: The European Union was as anxious as anyone for Middle East peace, but a lasting settlement was a matter for Israel and the Palestinians, the European Commission said on Thursday.

"It would be useful and acceptable for our role to be enhanced, but so far only one side has asked for it," said Josep Coll i Carbo, spokesman for Manuel Marin, the European Commissioner with responisbility for Middle Eastern affairs.
Coll i Carbo was responding to reporters' questions as to whether there might be a European initiative following calls by the Arab League for a greater EU role in the peace process.

"The responsiblity for peace lies with the partners and the sponsors (the United States and Russia)," he said. "We can't take the place of either of them ... our aim is to contribute to the restoration of the process but this can only be done if we are wanted."
Coll i Carbo said the issue was certain to be raised during a meeting of EU and Mediterranean Foreign Ministers in Malta later this month.
The meeting -- which will include Israel -- will go ahead despite a pledge by the Arab League on Monday to freeze relations with Israel.
Arab-Israeli relations have plummeted since Israel started building a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.

Ministers from the EU and the south Mediterranean, including Egypt, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan, Morocco, Tunisia, Algeria, the Palestinian Authority and Israel are due to meet in Malta on April 15 and 16 to assess progress in the Euro-Med Partnership agreed in Barcelona in 1995.
